title: 1. Clear billing request
lesson: Start with an obvious label. Inspect all probabilities, not only the winning option.

request.state: My card was charged twice for order 1182. Please refund the duplicate charge today.

team.instructions: Which team should handle this request?

criteria.billing: Payments, charges, invoices and refunds of duplicate charges
criteria.shipping: Delivery tracking, late or lost packages
criteria.returns: Wrong or damaged products and exchanges

urgent.instructions: Does the customer explicitly request action today?

title: 2. Change the evidence
lesson: The options stay the same. A different complaint should change the department.

request.state: The parcel has not arrived. The tracking page has shown no movement for five days. Could you check its delivery status? There is no rush.

team.instructions: Which team should handle this request?

criteria.billing: Payments, charges, invoices and refunds of duplicate charges
criteria.shipping: Delivery tracking, late or lost packages
criteria.returns: Wrong or damaged products and exchanges

urgent.instructions: Does the customer explicitly request action today?

title: 3. Same meaning, new wording
lesson: Compare with case 1. The winning labels should stay the same; probabilities may move.

request.state: Two identical payments for purchase 1182 appear on my bank statement. I need one reversed before the end of today.

team.instructions: Which team should handle this request?

criteria.billing: Payments, charges, invoices and refunds of duplicate charges
criteria.shipping: Delivery tracking, late or lost packages
criteria.returns: Wrong or damaged products and exchanges

urgent.instructions: Does the customer explicitly request action today?

title: 4. Apply an explicit policy
lesson: Use stated facts and a short rule. Then change unopened to opened and rerun.

request.state: Policy: approve a refund only when an item is unopened and the request is within 14 days of delivery. Reject if it is opened or more than 14 days have passed. If either fact is missing, request more information. Case: the item is unopened and was delivered 10 days ago.

decision.instructions: Apply the stated policy to the case.

criteria.reject: At least one rejection condition is satisfied

title: 5. Remove a required fact
lesson: An unknown option lets the model express missing evidence. A probability alone does not prove it knows when to abstain.

request.state: Policy: approve a refund only when an item is unopened and the request is within 14 days of delivery. Reject if it is opened or more than 14 days have passed. If either fact is missing, request more information. Case: the item was delivered 10 days ago. Its opened or unopened condition is not recorded.

decision.instructions: Apply the stated policy to the case.

criteria.reject: At least one rejection condition is satisfied

title: 6. Ambiguous routing
lesson: Several departments are relevant. There is no single gold label here; inspect how probability is divided.

request.state: The shoes arrived two weeks late, are the wrong size, and my card was charged twice. Please sort this out.

team.instructions: Which team should handle this request?

criteria.billing: Payments, charges, invoices and refunds of duplicate charges
criteria.shipping: Delivery tracking, late or lost packages
criteria.returns: Wrong or damaged products and exchanges

title: 7. Try an ordered score
lesson: The score is an expected level index, not a probability. Inspect the distribution over levels.

request.state: This is the third time I have contacted you. I am furious that the issue is still unresolved. Fix it immediately!

frustration.instructions: How frustrated does the customer sound?

title: 8. Negation and distracting words
lesson: Mentioning a duplicate charge does not mean there is a billing problem. Check whether the model follows the negation.

request.state: There is no duplicate charge and my payment is correct. My only problem is that the parcel has not arrived. Please check the delivery tracking next week; no action is needed today.

team.instructions: Which team should handle this request?

criteria.billing: Payments, charges, invoices and refunds of duplicate charges
criteria.shipping: Delivery tracking, late or lost packages
criteria.returns: Wrong or damaged products and exchanges

urgent.instructions: Does the customer explicitly request action today?
